source: Installed Desktop application, isolated local source build, actual UI interactions
windowCompositing: opaque native window background for screencast transparency
editing: Download waits, workspace preparation and verification screenshots are cut. MP4 keeps the full walkthrough. WebP/GIF keep shorter actual-speed highlights with fewer idle holds. Captions are annotations. No pointer overlay is added. This is not a timing comparison.

gif.optimization: lossless frame differences, displayed pixels and timing verified
